title: Wetour Robotics Launches Vantrapower to Expand into Intelligent Power Infrastructure for AI Industrial and Energy Markets in Texas
summary: New subsidiary will pursue transformer and power infrastructure opportunities across data centers, industrial facilities, energy storage and other...
body_markdown:
*New subsidiary will pursue transformer and power infrastructure opportunities across data centers, industrial facilities, energy storage and other high-load applications*


**AUSTIN, Texas, Sept. 17, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) --** Wetour Robotics Limited (Nasdaq: WETO) ("Wetour Robotics" or the "Company") today announced the launch of Vantrapower LLC, a newly formed subsidiary based in Austin, Texas, focused on transformer supply and power infrastructure opportunities serving data centers, industrial facilities, energy storage projects and other high-load applications. The initiative expands the Company's energy infrastructure capabilities and supports its positioning as an **AI infrastructure and automation integrator** serving computing, industrial and energy markets.


Vantrapower plans to focus initially on Texas and the broader North American market. The Company believes Texas offers significant potential demand for transformers and related power equipment across data centers, industrial facilities, energy storage projects and other high-load developments. The initiative is also intended to complement Wetour Robotics' work in AI-enabled robotics and industrial applications.


*"Growth across AI, industrial and energy markets is creating new requirements for reliable power equipment," said Nan Zheng, Chief Executive Officer of Wetour Robotics. "Vantrapower gives us a focused entry point through transformer supply. We plan to develop this business in a disciplined, milestone-based manner."*


Wetour Robotics plans to provide further updates as material commercial and partnership milestones are achieved.


**About Wetour Robotics Limited**


Wetour Robotics Limited (NASDAQ: WETO) is a Physical AI infrastructure and wearable robotics company headquartered in Austin, Texas. The Company is developing Orchestra, a Physical AI platform that connects intelligent agents to the physical world through wearable sensors, visual intelligence, edge AI computing and connected machines. Conductor is the Company’s wrist-worn neuromuscular interface, and VisionLink is its visual intelligence module.
